info.title: Candu Universal API
info.description: Candu lets teams drive in-app onboarding and product adoption with embeddable content, targeting data, and webhook-based event ingestion.

put.description: Associates a user with a group in Candu.

userId.description: The user ID to associate to the group.

traits.description: Optional group traits to update at the same time.

success.description: True when Candu accepts the event webhook request.
